description: ISO8601 前缀的 Linux auth.log（如 2026-06-24T01:06:24+08:00 host sshd: Accepted ...）
line_regex: ^(?P<timestamp>[^\s]+)\s+(?P<host>\S+)\s+sshd(?:\[\d+\])?:\s+(?P<result>Accepted|Failed|Invalid|Disconnected|Connection closed|error|fatal)\b(?: password| publickey)?(?: for invalid user| for)?\s+(?P<user>\S+)(?:\s+from\s+(?P<src_ip>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}))?
